name: folio
description: Magazine-style presentation skill that turns structured content into editable decks across HTML, PPTX, PDF, Figma, and IDML.
release_highlights: Added explicit portfolio page-type guidance for opener, proof, gallery, detail, and closing pages.
Added alignment rules for mixed-ratio image groups so top/bottom/grid alignment is intentional.
Fixed the lightweight PDF export so it now paginates one slide per page instead of collapsing into a single sheet.
Removed README and handoff references to screenshot assets that are not checked into this branch.
